Message.MsgText: Missing source file. Use command line switch to specify it.

Explanation.p: The user has not provided valid source file.

Message.MsgText: Cannot read file: file which was unable to read

Explanation.p: Either the specified path is invalid or the application has no rights to read the file.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the provided path is valid and that the user you execute the application with, has sufficient rights to read the file.

Explanation.p: The user has specified the same files for both input and output.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the two files are different.

Message.MsgText: Cannot write file: file which was unable to write

Explanation.p: Either the specified path is invalid or the application has no rights to write to the file.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the provided path is valid and that the user you execute the application with, has sufficient rights to write to it.

Message.MsgText: Cannot delete file: file which was unable to delete

Explanation.p: Either the specified path is invalid or the application has no rights to delete the file.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the provided path is valid and that the user you execute the application with, has sufficient rights to delete the file.

Message.MsgText: Cannot rename file filename of source file to filename of destination file

Explanation.p: Either the specified path is invalid or the application has no rights to rename the file.

OperatorResponse.p: Make sure the provided path is valid and that the user you execute the application with, has sufficient rights to rename the file.
